interface.name: openkaryon_keyboard_layout_v1
interface.description: A desktop panel can request the next layout without synthesizing keys or changing focus. The compositor updates its physical keyboard group, so normal keyboard input and per-window layout restoration stay consistent. Requests are ignored while the session is locked. Sandboxed clients must not be offered this interface. This private protocol may change in future versions; incompatible changes require a new interface name or version.
